verses.text: The last snow melts from the roof tiles one drop at a time.

verses.text:
gutter clogged with leaves
someone finally climbs the ladder
to clear what fall left behind

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
from the top rung
he waves at neighbors below—
sky wide and unclaimed

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone shouts up a question
he cups his ear, leaning out—
the whole street laughing at the answer
